decisions.chain_element: organize the sequence data with the text annotations as feature-ordered input

evidence.quote: We design the prompts to organize the sequence data with the text annotations as feature-ordered input for model pre-training ( Supplementary Table 1 ).

decisions.rationale: R6: organizing biological data as ordered prompt input is text serialization.

decisions.chain_element: partition the data into sentence-based chunks

evidence.quote: Subsequently, the nucleotide sequences and text annotations are partitioned into sentence-based chunks.

decisions.rationale: R6: partitioning into sentence-based chunks is a documented split operation.

decisions.chain_element: tokenize with SentencePiece byte pair encoding

evidence.quote: The data were tokenized with the byte pair encoding (BPE) algorithm 11 .
SentencePiece 13 is employed as the subword tokenizer, resulting in a dictionary containing 32, 001 tokens.

decisions.rationale: R6: SentencePiece BPE tokenization maps the sequence into discrete tokens.

decisions.chain_element: add special tokens <s> and </s>

evidence.quote: We include a special token <s> at the beginning and a special token </s> at the end of the sequence.

decisions.rationale: R6: special tokens marking sequence structure are serialization delimiters.

decisions.chain_element: embed the input tokens and add GPTNeo positional encodings

evidence.quote: The token embedding layer embedded the input tokens into embedding vectors. We add GPTNeo positional encodings 14 to the token embeddings.

decisions.rationale: R6: token embedding is a lookup followed by the stated addition of positional encodings.

operation_proposals.source_operation: estimate LL difference between paired sequences
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has arithmetic addition and numerical transforms, but no operation for obtaining model log-likelihoods and computing their difference.
The catalog does not represent deriving a model-specific mutation-effect score from likelihood outputs.
The catalog has a log transform, but it does not represent model-estimated log-likelihood differences.
